metadata.changelog: 1.1.6 — Floor plan as pure HTML/CSS (no SVG; html-snippet sanitizes SVG). 1.1.5 — Floor plan via HTML/SVG widget (mimic props fixed under platform.mimics.storetwin-floor). 1.1.4 — Operator visuals without images: SCADA mimic floor + HTML planogram/shelf widgets. 1.1.3 — UI preview SVGs on operator dashboards (floor / planograms / shelf). 1.1.2 — Operator: KPI sales/traffic reports, tasks+lifecycle, integrations+ping. 1.1.1 — Operator dashboards/reports: planogram shelves/SKU/issues + shelf faces/equipment_ids. 1.1.0 — UI parity: nested planograms (shelves/SKU/issues), lifecycle, KPIs, users; 15 BFF with app dataSourcePath; seed from mock.ts. 1.0.0 — v1 domain model.
metadata.deployNote: Stand requires signed license for import_package; deployed piecemeal via MCP. Tree script functions MUST set dataSourcePath=root.platform.data-sources.storetwin (otherwise SQL hits default DS and tables appear missing).
